info.name: PBL6 Round 3 SRS notification provider failure

item.name: AUTH-08 Register during notification provider outage

exec: pm.test('Registration remains accepted when email delivery fails',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(202));

item.name: AUTH-08 Account remains pending during notification outage

exec: pm.test('Notification error did not silently activate account',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(401);pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.include('accessToken');});
